entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes. I... I'm a bit lost. I think I need to return an item, a jersey I bought, but the website was just so confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. I'm just pulling up your account now. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

It's a preference, I guess? It's just the wrong size. It's way too tight across the chest and I wanted to do an exchange, but I couldn't figure out the forms. I'm just not very good with these things. Can't you just help me?

Of course. I understand the online process can sometimes be a bit much. Let's get this sorted out for you right now. I see the order here from last month. You're well within our 90-day return window for apparel.
Oh, really? I thought I read something about 10 days and I got worried I missed it. It's so hard to keep track.

No need to worry, that's for some of our newer electronic items. Since this is a standard jersey, the 90-day policy applies. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. You just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Wow, that's it? That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
